content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on programming a [product_name] [article_no] and realized that my installed [product_name] [version_no] isn't compatible with this device. I completed the process to download export-restricted software to get the upgrade to [version_no], but received an email from [company_name] asking to provide company information in my profile. Since I am not associated with any company, what should I enter in these fields? Regards, [user_name].
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. If you are not affiliated with a company, you can try entering 'Private use' in the company field.

Hi [user_name], thanks for your feedback. I followed your suggestion, but received a similar response from [company_name]: Please provide or correct your official company name including legal form (such as GmbH, AG, KG, Ltd., Plc., LLC, Corp., Inc., etc.), or alternatively, the official name of your university or college. Is there anything else I can do? I have [product_name] [version_no] installed and urgently need an upgrade to program [product_name] [article_no]. Regards.
You might find further help by asking other users. Alternatively, you could contact the forum moderator, who may be able to connect you with the appropriate department for download approval.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced difficulties upgrading the necessary software for a specific [company_name] device due to company information requirements during restricted software download. The ambiguity surrounding access procedures for individuals without company ties creates obstacles and confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to download and install the required software update as a private person, without needing to supply company credentials.
